A permission request dialog box with a folder icon. The text reads: "Allow myMail to access photos, media, and files on your device?" There are two buttons at the bottom: "DENY" and "ALLOW."

compos.summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a permission request dialog from the app "myMail." The dialog is asking for permission to access photos, media, and files on the device. There are two options for the user to choose from: "DENY" and "ALLOW." The background of the screen shows a message with additional information and two buttons at the bottom: "ALLOW TO ACCESS" and "SKIP." The top of the screen has a back arrow and the title "No access." The status bar at the top shows various icons and the time "11:11."
